description: Aggregate a vendor's NEW YORK STATE contract awards from the Procurement Report for State Authorities on data.ny.gov: total dollars awarded, number of contracts, and a breakdown by awarding agency/authority and by fiscal year. Matches the vendor name as a case-insensitive substring, so it also surfaces name variants (e.g. "IBM CORP" vs "IBM LC LODGING"). Use this to size up a single vendor's business with New York State authorities. This is NEW YORK STATE data (not federal, not New York City).

fiscal_year.description: Optional: restrict to one reporting fiscal year (calendar year of the fiscal-year-end date), e.g. 2022.

vendor.description: Vendor name to aggregate (case-insensitive substring), e.g. "Deloitte", "IBM".

name: ny_procurement_vendor
title: Ny Procurement Vendor
